definitions.gloss: one after another; successively; in rapid succession
definitions.explanation: Describes multiple things or people appearing, arriving, or happening in quick succession without pause. Conveys a sense of continuous flow or momentum.

examples.japanese: ⟦{客|きゃく}→客：00865_kyaku⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{続々|ぞくぞく}と⟦{集|あつ}まった→集まる：01162_atsumaru⟧。
⟦{新|あたら}しい→新しい：00506_atarashii⟧⟦{情報|じょうほう}→情報：03348_jouhou⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{続々|ぞくぞく}と⟦{入|はい}ってくる→入ってくる：29060_haittekuru⟧。
examples.english: New information keeps pouring in one after another.

examples.japanese: ⟦{開店|かいてん}→開店：14569_kaiten⟧⟦セール→セール：07780_seeru⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{日|ひ}→日：02249_hi⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧、⟦{朝|あさ}→朝：02277_asa⟧⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧{買|か}い{物客|ものきゃく}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{続々|ぞくぞく}と⟦{店|みせ}→店：00497_mise⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{押|お}し{寄|よ}せた→押し寄せる：06733_oshiyoseru⟧。
examples.english: On the day of the opening sale, shoppers flocked to the store one after another from the morning.

notes:
USAGE:
{続々|ぞくぞく}と is an adverb describing things happening in rapid succession. The ⟦と→と：00512_to⟧ particle is optional but commonly included. It is used with verbs of appearance, arrival, or emergence.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {続々|ぞくぞく}と⟦{集|あつ}まる→集まる：01162_atsumaru⟧ (to gather one after another)
- {続々|ぞくぞく}と⟦{届|とど}く→届く：00899_todoku⟧ (to arrive in succession)
- {続々|ぞくぞく}と⟦{発売|はつばい}→発売：04315_hatsubai⟧⟦される→する：00392_suru⟧ (to be released one after another)
- {続々|ぞくぞく}と⟦{参加|さんか}する→参加する：25408_sankasuru⟧ (to join one after another)

WATCH OUT:
Do not confuse with ぞくぞく⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧ (to shiver, to get chills), which describes a physical sensation. {続々|ぞくぞく}と always modifies a verb describing successive events.
